about: Every response of the NIST Atomic Spectra Database that the emission spectra of the periodic table are built from, as it was returned on the retrieval date, one request at a time. For each of the 118 elements there is the response to the query named neutral-visible; for each element that query returned no table for, there is also the response to the query named all. README.md in this folder says how the two queries were made and what a response that is not a table looks like.
